abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) carries a poor prognosis despite curative-intent resection and adjuvant therapy. Gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (Gem-NAP) has become a standard adjuvant regimen for PDAC, yet recurrence rates remain high. This study aimed to identify clinical and pathological factors associated with recurrence and survival in patients receiving adjuvant Gem-NAP following PDAC resection.
METHODS: We retrospectively identified 210 patients with resected PDAC who received adjuvant gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel at a single institution between May 2017 and October 2024. Clinicopathological characteristics, recurrence patterns, disease-free survival (DFS), and overall survival (OS) were analyzed. Univariate and multivariate models were utilized to identify independent predictors of recurrence and survival.
RESULTS: In total, 132 patients (62.9%) experienced recurrence, with a median DFS of 21.0 months (95% CI: 16.7-25.3) and a median OS of 39.0 months (95% CI: 32.7-45.3). Local recurrence (28.6%) and liver metastasis (24.8%) were the most common recurrence sites. Multivariable analysis revealed that preoperative CA19-9 > 37 U/mL (OR: 2.28; 95% CI: 1.19-4.34; p = 0.01) and a lymph node ratio (LNR) > 0.14 (OR: 2.98; 95% CI: 1.19-7.47; p = 0.02) were significantly associated with recurrence. Independent predictors of worse DFS included elevated preoperative CA19-9 (> 37 U/mL) (HR: 1.59; 95% CI: 1.04-2.43; p = 0.03), LNR > 0.14 (HR: 1.88; 95% CI: 1.23-2.89; p < 0.01), R1 resection (HR: 2.71; 95% CI: 1.36-5.38; p < 0.01), and lymphovascular invasion (LVI) (HR: 1.59; 95% CI: 1.09-2.30; p = 0.02). For OS, the independent predictors were R1 resection (HR: 3.00; 95% CI: 1.45-6.22; p < 0.01), LVI positivity (HR: 1.55; 95% CI: 1.03-2.34; p = 0.04), and LNR > 0.14 (HR: 1.76; 95% CI: 1.11-2.80; p = 0.02).
CONCLUSIONS: Recurrence after adjuvant gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel in patients with resected pancreatic cancer remains common. A high lymph node ratio, R1 resection, and lymphovascular invasion were powerful independent predictors of both poor DFS and OS.

title: Factors Associated With Recurrence After Adjuvant Gemcitabine and Nab-Paclitaxel in Patients With Resected Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
